@graph.name: Taroko Gorge Ecosystem Archive
@graph.description: Research archive of Nick Montfort's Taroko Gorge (2009) and its remixes. Covers 61 candidate URLs: downloaded HTML/JS source files, extracted lexical arrays, Playwright screenshots and runtime text traces, and structured metadata. Source code is the primary archival object for generative works.
